title: Rassemblements simultanés à Séguéla autour de la désignation de Bouaké Fofana comme candidat régional
reason: The AIP report identifies a support gathering and an opposing march concerning the RHDP internal nomination of a candidate for regional elections. The published 300 count applies only to the village/community chiefs at the support ceremony; no turnout is reported for the opposing march. Neither is described as making a state-policy demand; this is a party/electoral nomination dispute.
notes: Two separate actions are described. Do not transfer the 300 supporters to the opposing march. KOACI search-only result is a separate outlet, but no independent turnout or state-policy target is established.

title: Paro de producción de pan anunciado para el 6–7 de febrero y suspendido tras encuentro con el gobierno
reason: The action was a bakery work stoppage over flour prices; the opened Abidjan.net report says most bakeries were open and that talks with authorities were scheduled. No qualifying public gathering or protest meeting is documented in opened body evidence. Work stoppage alone does not establish a public gathering.
notes: Sources conflict on breadth of work stoppage: Anadolu search snippet reports broad stoppage while Abidjan.net’s contemporaneous observed sample says most bakeries opened. Neither is participant turnout at a public gathering. The announced 48-hour period was suspended on 6 February after talks.
